interface.signature: int n, int m, int edges[m][2], int s -> int[n-1]

preconditions.description: The number of queries q is between 1 and 10.
The number of nodes n is between 2 and 1000.
The number of edges m is between 1 and the maximum possible edges in an undirected graph with n nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) connects nodes u and v, where u and v are between 1 and n.
The starting node s is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The returned array has exactly n-1 elements, representing distances to all nodes except the start node s.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and i != s for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The returned array corresponds to nodes in increasing order, excluding the start node s.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i - 1] == -1 or return_value[i - 1] % 6 == 0 for i in range(1, n + 1) if i != s)
postconditions.description: For each node i (excluding s), the distance is either -1 (unreachable) or a non-negative multiple of 6.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i - 1] == -1 or return_value[i - 1] == 6 * shortest_path_length for i in range(1, n + 1) if i != s)
postconditions.description: For each node i (excluding s), the distance is -1 if unreachable, otherwise it is 6 times the shortest path length from s to i using BFS.
